capabilities.complete_execution: One geometry candidate through the existing backend, fixed task evaluation and sampled holding/profile report. No search or additional local checks. Defer/reject leaves the execution allowance unused.

instructions: Read the accepted diagnosis. Make a separate native ImprovementDecision: adopt with an explicit justified delta, or defer/reject with empty changes. Use only the supplied original three-variable geometry grant. Controller weights, materials, force limits and task changes are not authorized. Do not force a geometry change to consume the allowance. State expected measurable effects separately for reach, sampled holding, and computation; uncertainty is allowed. The decision records intent only; the host subsequently validates/builds and may execute exactly one candidate. Unsupported recommendations remain specific future grant/integration work. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.

recommendations.rationale: Historical full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained and no closed-loop counterfactual replay exists, so no specific parameter change is justified; defer any change until iteration-level evidence is available.

Controller weights are outside the physical grant for this phase, and the residual speed could reflect timing, horizon, warm-start, or model factors; defer any settling/tip-speed weighting change pending a saved-state check.

attribution.reason: In the final 0.05 s window recorded tip speeds stayed roughly 0.64-1.58 m/s versus the 0.02 m/s settling speed limit while position error fell below the 0.01 m tolerance only at the last sample, so the sampled settle failed on the speed criterion.

Mean update wall time 17.30 s against a 0.01 s control period shows plans were not computed within a single control interval, but the scheduling note states synchronous calls finish before fixed backend steps and wall-clock misses do not inject simulated delay, and a single execution cannot establish a causal contribution to residual motion.

Recorded effective_horizon values late in the run (1-7) were below the configured horizon 10, which could limit terminal speed regulation, but no counterfactual replay exists to test the contribution.

initialization_selected 29 versus noninitialization_selected 6 and 34/35 selections recording 'User_Requested_Stop' indicate mostly initialization-seeded, budget-truncated plans rather than converged warm solves; their contribution to residual tip speed is not established.
reach_passed is recorded true and terminal error 0.007642608585867386 m is below reach_tolerance_m 0.01 m, so reach did not fail.

Predicted versus measured endpoint velocities differ by up to about 0.12 m/s, but the projection is a bounded-horizon projected GVS state probe and cannot by itself explain the whole settling failure, and input/causal equivalence is not proven.

facts.statement: Within the sampled final settling window (t = 0.30-0.35 s; settling.window_s 0.05), recorded measured backend tip speed stayed far above the settling speed_limit_m_s 0.02 - measured_speed_m_s 1.32948286853263 (t=0.31), 1.4769184551353305 (t=0.32), 0.7758084264853817 (t=0.34) and 0.6351726092425104 (t=0.35) - while recorded tip error fell from late_max_error_m 0.05813810428573256 m to terminal_error_m 0.007642608585867386 m (reaching below position_limit_m 0.01 m only at t=0.35); sampled_settling_passed is recorded false despite terminal_speed_m_s 0.6351726092425104 m/s.

At matched one-step endpoints for updates 27-34 the recorded projected predictions were close to but not equal to measured tip motion: predicted_next_error_m 0.04162771013275348 vs actual_next_error_m 0.04778599698437965 (update 30) and 0.007929056236766449 vs 0.007642608585867386 (update 34); recorded velocity vector_difference_norm_m_s ranged 0.021386880777076088 to 0.12414427543983646 across the recorded intervals, and the projected-state comparison is labeled 'recorded projected states, not full backend-state error'.

The recorded per-update effective_horizon for the late updates was 7 (update 28), 6 (29), 5 (30), 4 (31), 2 (33) and 1 (34) control intervals, all below the configured recipe.horizon 10; the run records initialization_selected 29 and noninitialization_selected 6, with selection.optimization_selected_iteration 0 for updates 27-28 and 64 for update 33.

limitations: Only the final settling window (t = 0.30-0.35 s, 6 motion samples) was read from the motion view; earlier backend samples (t = 0.01-0.29 s) are retained but were not read in this context.
Only controller updates 27-34 were read from the prediction and plans views; updates 0-26 were not read here.
Full historical warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained (control_snapshots.json), so iteration-level behavior cannot be inspected.
No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution capability exists; single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause.
The handed-off summary values deadline_misses 35 and late_max_speed_m_s (1.5810152739742807) are recorded but no matching fact handle was selected from the current catalog.

Frames: tip vectors are world frame; projected-state differences are recorded GVS coordinates, not full backend-state error; raw controller weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling.
Scheduling note: synchronous calls finish before fixed backend steps and wall-clock deadline misses do not inject simulated delay; timing is a recorded observation only.
recommended_actions: If authorized in a later phase, evaluate via a saved-state numerical check whether a terminal tip-speed-related control term or a longer effective horizon improves the holding speed; no check is selected or executed here.
Restore retention of full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces (control_snapshots.json) so iteration-level diagnosis becomes possible.
Extend evidence coverage to sampled backend motion before t = 0.30 s and to effective_horizon for updates 0-26 before drawing any global profile conclusion.
Treat the recorded reach success and sampled settling failure as coexisting observations, not as a proven causal chain.
